message.title: A message from Antares
message.body: AI moves fast, remaking itself by the day. As an AI product manager, despite keeping one eye on the frontier in Silicon Valley, but keep focusing on the business problem we are solving for. Product is one tactic in solving the problem so don't lost in product features. A note to myself, and to everyone who build.
